Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning recommendations for streamlining reporting requirements for taxes and fees on spirits.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to recommendations for streamlining reportingrequirements for taxes and fees on spirits; adding a new section tochapter 66.08 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the adoption ofInitiative Measure No. 1183 by the voters in 2011 privatized the saleand distribution of spirits in Washington. The legislature also findsthat reporting requirements for all liquor taxes and fees areadministratively complex and require payment and reporting to multiplestate agencies.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By September 30, 2013, and in compliance with RCW 43.01.036, theboard and the department of revenue must make recommendations to thelegislature that detail the statutory changes necessary to: Streamlinethe collection of liquor taxes, fees, and reports; and require a p. 1 SB 5238singular state agency to be responsible for the collection of thisrevenue and information.
